Every entry below comes from the registry used by the CLI, TUI Action Hub, previews, jobs, and local API.

## ap

| Command ID | Invocation | Safety | Output | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ap-list` | `netops ap list '<target>'` | `read-only` | `table` | Search current reconciled AP inventory. |
| `ap-moves` | `netops ap moves` | `read-only` | `table` | Show recorded AP attachment changes newest first. |
| `ap-on-switch` | `netops ap on-switch '<target>'` | `read-only` | `table` | Show canonical APs attached to a switch or site. |
| `ap-scan` | `netops ap scan` | `network-read/local-write` | `log` | Refresh AP inventory. |
| `ap-timeline` | `netops ap timeline '<target>'` | `read-only` | `table` | Show AP attachment history newest first. |
| `ap-unjoined` | `netops ap unjoined '<target>'` | `read-only` | `table` | List AP observations that are not joined to a controller. |
